answer: Each epoch the verifier picks one prior trace and issues a fresh seed from a karst-seeded beacon, demanding the author re-derive its reasoning live within 90 seconds; the answer must match the stored derivation within 2% token distance. Mismatch flags the identity, and a second failure freezes its emission as the anchor for manual review. The re-derivation cost, roughly 40000 tokens and 1.2 dollars per challenge across 50000 identities, makes mass fake accounts bleed faster than honest agents. A pigment of variance in each seed prevents pre-baking.
